messages:
Ben_Customer: Hi, exporting our usage CSV for Oct 1-7 and I'm missing rows for 2024-10-03 and 2024-10-05. Dashboard shows activity on those days but the CSV has zeros. Invoice ID INV-2024-11-1223. Can someone look?

alice_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the top of the CSV (first 20 lines) and the exact export command you used? Also is this via the Console export or the /v1/usage/exports API?

Ben_Customer: Console export. Here's a snippet from the CSV we downloaded:

```
date,customer_id,tokens,requests
2024-10-01,acct_9,12034,46
2024-10-02,acct_9,43021,152
2024-10-03,acct_9,0,0
2024-10-04,acct_9,27512,98
2024-10-05,acct_9,0,0
2024-10-06,acct_9,31122,110
```

emma_support: Thanks Ben. Can you also confirm the timezone / account timezone? Sometimes the Console export uses UTC and dashboard is in customer timezone which can show apparent gaps.

Ben_Customer: We're on America/Los_Angeles. Dashboard is showing ~35k tokens on 2024-10-03 and ~22k on 2024-10-05. Invoice line items also include those ranges so I'm worried invoice != CSV export.

metrics_bot: Export job job_9472 status: FAILED at 2024-10-05T04:12:11Z (partition read timeout). Retry attempts: 2.

devon_dataeng: I'm on it. If job_9472 failed during partition read, that would drop rows for the affected partition dates. Can you share the export job id (should be in the UI export modal) and the account id?

Ben_Customer: Job id is job_9472 and account id acct_9. I clicked export on 2024-10-07 from the Console UI.

devon_dataeng: Thanks. Quick check: ingestion logs show metering shards for acct_9 were processed but partition for 2024-10-03 had a transient S3 list error, which the export job didn't retry correctly. That matches metrics_bot.

cara_billing: From billing side, invoice INV-2024-11-1223 was generated from the canonical metering table, which includes the backfill process, so invoice totals include the 10/3 and 10/5 tokens. Console CSV export reads the pre-aggregation export snapshot — if the export job failed it can miss those rows. We need a re-export or run the backfill and re-run job_9472.

alice_support: Ok — Devon, can we re-run a corrected export for job_9472 and/or schedule a backfill for those dates? What's the ETA?

devon_dataeng: Plan: (1) Trigger backfill for partitions 2024-10-03 and 2024-10-05 into canonical table; (2) Re-run export job_9472 as a manual job pointing at the corrected snapshot. Repro steps for ops: 

```
# run backfill for account
POST /internal/metering/backfill
payload: {"account_id":"acct_9","dates":["2024-10-03","2024-10-05"]}

# re-run export
POST /v1/usage/exports
{"account_id":"acct_9","start_date":"2024-10-01","end_date":"2024-10-07","source":"manual-reexport","reference_job":"job_9472"}
```

devon_dataeng: I already queued the backfill (backfill_2204). Expected completion in ~45 minutes. Re-export will run after completion. I'll post the new export job id here.

emma_support: Thanks Devon — Ben, we'll DM you once the new CSV is ready and include checksums and a diff against the original CSV so you can see inserted rows.

Ben_Customer: Appreciate it. Will need a confirmation that invoice amounts won't change — does a backfill alter billed tokens?

cara_billing: Backfill does not change already issued invoices. Billing uses canonical metering cut at invoice time. If the invoice included those tokens, totals will match. The Console export is a convenience snapshot; it can differ if exports fail. Sorry for the confusion.

devon_dataeng: Backfill finished (backfill_2204) at 2024-10-07T12:10:03Z. New export job created: job_9621. metrics_bot: Export job job_9621 status: COMPLETED at 2024-10-07T12:35:47Z.

alice_support: New CSV uploaded to customer bucket. Checksums: original_csv_crc32: abc123 (incomplete), new_csv_crc32: def456. I've attached a quick diff: 2 rows added for 2024-10-03 and 2024-10-05, tokens roughly 35,120 and 22,410 respectively.

Ben_Customer: Got it — thanks all. Please leave this open until I confirm with finance that numbers reconcile.

emma_support: Will keep thread open. Tagging @cara_billing for visibility. :thumbsup:

cara_billing: Confirmed with finance: invoice INV-2024-11-1223 already included those tokens, no credit needed. Marking as resolved from billing side when customer confirms.

Ben_Customer: Confirmed internally, numbers reconcile, thanks for the quick turnaround. Closing on my side. :tada:
